about: The WynlandOS logo as vectors: traced from logo.png. Coordinates in pixels of the 1114 x 1111 original, about its centre (+x right, +y down). Each blade: its outline (a closed polygon), its colour a cubic polynomial in u, v = (point - centre) / size: c = k0 + k1 u + k2 v + k3 u^2 + k4 uv + k5 v^2 + k6 u^3 + k7 u^2 v + k8 u v^2 + k9 v^3 (0..255). Seams: the thin dark lines between overlapping blades.
